action.objective: Verify Qxh8, the strongest broad-search candidate (exact 993 at depth 2), for tactical safety and forced-mate refutations before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search over all roots returned g7h8 as top exact candidate (score 993, pv g7h8 d8c8). This action is a single-candidate verification using the reserved 2000-node allowance, targeting context.budget.max_depth 4, with full root window and mate-in-one safety checks. Black's h1 queen is loose; Qxh8 removes it while keeping pressure and she is not clearly recapturable (Ke8 bishop on d8 is pinned to king, so no BxQ recapture). No prior refutation is recorded; the probe is bounded, so I will report uncertainty rather than claim general safety.
